demand.statement: CLI users must initialize a FastAPI repository with retornatus init --preset fastapi. The preset extends python-platform, adds scope globs for app/, src/, routers/, api/, schemas/, and alembic/, comments suggested evidence commands for pytest with httpx TestClient, an OpenAPI JSON export, and optional alembic check or alembic upgrade head --sql, and treats alembic migration paths as a ship surface that requires a rollback note. Out of scope: a version bump, Django presets, merging, and publishing.
